name: Summit Waterproof Hiking Boots
description: Durable, waterproof Gore-Tex hiking boots with excellent ankle support. Perfect for wet climates and rocky terrain. Features a Vibram outsole for maximum grip.

name: Trailblazer Daypack 25L
description: Lightweight 25-liter daypack with a breathable mesh back panel. Includes a hydration sleeve and multiple quick-access pockets for day hikes.

name: Cascade Rain Jacket
description: Ultra-lightweight, packable rain jacket. Fully seam-taped and windproof. Ideal for unpredictable weather and layering.

name: Basecamp 2-Person Tent
description: Spacious 2-person, 3-season freestanding tent. Easy setup with color-coded aluminum poles. Includes a rainfly and dual vestibules.

name: Alpine Trekking Poles
description: Adjustable carbon fiber trekking poles with cork grips. Shock-absorbing and incredibly lightweight to reduce knee strain on descents.

name: Glacier Down Sleeping Bag
description: 20-degree rated goose down sleeping bag with a mummy cut for maximum warmth-to-weight ratio. Compresses small for easy packing.

name: Ridgeline Fleece Pullover
description: Midweight fleece pullover made from recycled polyester. Soft brushed interior for warmth without bulk, great as a mid-layer.

name: Backcountry Water Filter
description: Compact hollow-fiber water filter that removes 99.9% of bacteria and protozoa. Filters up to 1000 liters before replacement.

name: Summit Insulated Gloves
description: Waterproof, touchscreen-compatible insulated gloves rated for sub-zero temperatures. Reinforced palm for grip on cold, wet trails.

name: Voyager Camp Stove
description: Ultralight titanium backpacking stove that boils water in under 3 minutes. Folds flat and fits inside most cookware sets.

name: Highland Trail Running Shoes
description: Breathable trail running shoes with aggressive lug pattern for loose terrain. Rock plate protects feet on technical trails.

name: Expedition Base Layer Top
description: Merino wool base layer that regulates temperature and resists odor on multi-day trips. Flatlock seams prevent chafing.

name: Pinnacle Headlamp 400
description: Rechargeable LED headlamp with 400-lumen max output and red night-vision mode. Lightweight, weatherproof housing.

name: Ridgeback Sun Hat
description: Wide-brim UPF 50+ sun hat with adjustable chin strap and ventilated mesh crown for hot, exposed trails.

name: Timberline Camp Chair
description: Packable aluminum-frame camp chair supporting up to 300 lbs. Sets up in seconds and fits inside its own stuff sack.

name: Frostline Insulated Jacket
description: Synthetic-insulated puffer jacket that retains warmth even when wet. Packs down into its own chest pocket.

name: Canyon Crossing Sandals
description: Quick-drying river sandals with a grippy rubber outsole, built for stream crossings and camp downtime.

name: Alpine Ice Axe
description: Lightweight aluminum ice axe designed for glacier travel and steep snow slopes. Includes a wrist leash and rubber spike guard.

name: Wanderer Compression Sacks (3-Pack)
description: Set of three nylon compression sacks in varying sizes to shrink bulky clothing and sleeping bags for efficient packing.

name: Northface Thermal Beanie
description: Snug-fitting merino blend beanie that traps heat without overheating your head on cold-weather hikes.

name: Ranger GPS Wristwatch
description: Rugged GPS watch with altimeter, barometer, and compass. Tracks routes offline for up to 20 hours of battery life.

name: Pathfinder Convertible Pants
description: Quick-dry hiking pants that zip off into shorts. Articulated knees for mobility and a gusseted crotch for scrambling.

name: Summit Bivy Sack
description: Emergency waterproof bivy sack designed to fit over a sleeping bag for unplanned overnight shelter in the backcountry.

name: Cross-Country Ski Poles
description: Lightweight aluminum ski poles with adjustable straps and wide baskets for deep snow stability.

name: Everest Approach Shoes
description: Sticky-rubber approach shoes built for scrambling and mixed terrain, with a low-profile design for climbing precision.
